dimensions.name: session_integrity
dimensions.detail: 98% events carry session_id; 100% of 1500 sessions are time-ordered

dimensions.name: identity_stability
dimensions.detail: 82% events carry user_id; 0 session(s) span multiple user IDs

dimensions.name: naming_consistency
dimensions.detail: 28/32 observed tags resolve to the taxonomy

dimensions.name: automation_binding
dimensions.detail: 27/28 screens have a Page Object binding

remediation: [action_coverage] Instrument interaction events (taps, submits, failures) - screen views alone give sequence but no intent, so mined journeys cannot be scored by business value.

[naming_consistency] Unmapped tags seen in production: HomeV2 (14x), ExperimentalPLP (14x), DebugScreen (10x), LegacyCheckout (7x). Either add them to the taxonomy or fix the app's tagging - unmapped events are silently dropped from every journey.
[identity_stability] Set a stable user identity at login and keep it across reinstall. Without it, cohorting and per-user journey analysis degrade to per-session only.
[automation_binding] Bind remaining screens to Page Objects. Unbound screens produce journey specs that Phase 4 cannot resolve into executable steps.
